public.description: Anthropic's published /security-review command (MIT). Vendored verbatim with its licence.

builtin.description: The /security-review prompt bundled in Claude Code. Proprietary: its text is never stored here, only a SHA-256 of the normalized body.
known_differences_from_public: Observed in Claude Code 2.1.283 and 2.1.284. The DIFF CONTENT step reviews committed changes since the merge base with origin/HEAD only (three-dot diff); the public copy's --merge-base form also includes uncommitted working-tree changes.
Outside the hashed body: allowed-tools also grants PowerShell forms of the same read-only git commands, and the command refuses to run outside a git repository.
